# pizx

> A zx fork with native Pi AI integration on the cordis plugin framework — AI-powered shell scripting for Node.js. Scripts get template-tag "letters" as globals: π (text generation), Π (coding agent), α (any ACP-compatible agent), ε (any CLI AI harness — claude, kiro-cli, …), and TypeSafe's typed decisions choice/score/noul, plus user-definable letters. Runs are traceable and exportable as JSONL, and cacheable letters hit a local result cache.

pizx scripts start with `#!/usr/bin/env pizx` and use `$`, `π`, `Π`, `α`, `ε`
(and any letters you define) as globals. pizx is also usable as a library via
`createPizx()` or `import '@topce/pizx/globals'`. The π/Π letters use Pi
credentials (`pi auth login`); α drives an external ACP server and ε drives an
external harness binary — neither needs pi. The TypeSafe letters need a
`TYPESAFE_API_KEY`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical guide for AI agents writing pizx scripts and CLI invocations — script template, the letters and ASCII aliases, LetterOutput shape, options, and the CLI --json/exit-code contract.
- [README](README.md): Project overview, quick start, feature tour, and CLI reference.
- [π reference](docs/pi.md): The π text-generation letter and its options.
- [Π reference](docs/capital-pi.md): The Π coding-agent letter, tools, and options.
- [α reference](docs/acp.md): The α ACP-agent letter and its server configuration.
- [ε reference](docs/epsilon.md): The ε CLI-harness letter, flag passthrough, and harness spec plugins.
- [TypeSafe](docs/typesafe.md): Typed, calibrated decisions — the choice/score/noul letters, the `ctx.typesafe` service, and the fanout/composite/gate/intent pattern words.
- [Defining letters](docs/extension.md): The cordis plugin API for custom letters.
- [Words](docs/words.md): Composing letters into AI patterns — the word library (ralph, fleet, chain, route, vote, refine, orchestrate, fanout, composite, gate, intent) and the `ctx.words` service.
- [Trace & logs](docs/trace.md): JSONL event format, log export, and cache behavior.
- [Onboarding](docs/onboarding.md): Architecture and file map.

## Optional

- [API audit](docs/api-audit.md): Notes on the public API surface.
- [α design idea](docs/ideas/acp-alpha.md): Rationale and roadmap for the ACP letter.
